name: companionship
quote: Going to hang out with a friend tonight.
description: A comfortable feeling of social validation from another person or animal.

variations.name: well-rounded friend
variations.description: People who have seen each other in a variety of moods and contexts and still look forward to being around each other.

variations.name: focused friend
variations.description: A relationship that is supportive and friendly in a limited context.

variations.name: spiritual friend
variations.description: A relationship between people who can share deep existential conversations.

variations.name: animal companion
variations.description: Pets and other animal relationships can alleviate stress and connect us with nature.

variations.name: utility friendship
variations.description: Keeping in touch with someone in part because that relationship brings status or could be beneficial in the future.
examples: She's pretty nice and knows about all the job openings in my industry.

variations.name: false friendship
variations.description: Keeping in touch with someone only because that relationship brings status or could be beneficial in the future.
examples: I really can't stand her, but she knows about all the job openings in my industry.

commentaries.quote: It's pretty common for us to work very hard over a long time to get a thumbs-up from friends.
The only way to have a friend is to be one.
The bird a nest, the spider a web, man friendship.

conditions: A sense of social validation from interacting with another person or animal
